mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT dr.product_id, p.product_code, p.product_name, p.product_type, p.product_specifications, p.measure_unit, pt.product_type_id, pt.parent_id, pt.ancestors, pt.product_type_name, OB.OBPlanQuantity, OB.OBMoney, CB.CBPlanQuantity, CB.CBMoney, EI.warehousing_name, EI.EIPlanQuantity, EI.EIMoney, ER.retrieval_name, ER.ERPlanQuantity, ER.ERMoney from detail_receipt dr JOIN product p ON dr.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_type pt ON pt.product_type_id = p.product_type
left join ( SELECT dr.product_id, COALESCE(SUM(case when hr.receipt_type in (1, 4, 5, 8, 10) then dr.plan_quantity when hr.receipt_type in (2, 3, 6, 7, 9) then -dr.plan_quantity else 0 end), 0) as OBPlanQuantity, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(case when hr.receipt_type in (1, 4, 5, 8, 10) then dr.money when hr.receipt_type in (2, 3, 6, 7, 9) then -dr.money else 0 end), 0), 2) as OBMoney from detail_receipt dr join head_receipt hr on hr.systematic_receipt = dr.systematic_receipt where hr.receipt_status = 2
and date_format(hr.invoice_date,'%y%m%d') < date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%y%m%d')
GROUP BY product_id ) OB on dr.product_id = OB.product_id
left join ( SELECT dr.product_id, w.warehouse_name AS warehousing_name, sum(dr.plan_quantity) as EIPlanQuantity, ROUND(sum(dr.money), 2) as EIMoney from detail_receipt dr join head_receipt hr on hr.systematic_receipt = dr.systematic_receipt JOIN warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = CASE WHEN hr.receipt_type IN (7) THEN dr.retrieval_id ELSE dr.warehousing_id END WHERE hr.receipt_status = 2
AND date_format(hr.invoice_date,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%y%m%d')
AND date_format(hr.invoice_date,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%y%m%d')
AND (hr.receipt_type in (1, 4, 5, 7, 10) or (hr.receipt_type in (8) AND dr.plan_quantity > 0)) GROUP BY dr.product_id, w.warehouse_name ) EI on dr.product_id = EI.product_id
left join ( SELECT dr.product_id, wr.warehouse_name AS retrieval_name, SUM(dr.plan_quantity) AS ERPlanQuantity, ROUND(SUM(dr.money), 2) AS ERMoney FROM detail_receipt dr JOIN head_receipt hr ON hr.systematic_receipt = dr.systematic_receipt JOIN warehouse wr ON wr.warehouse_id = dr.retrieval_id WHERE hr.receipt_status = 2
AND date_format(hr.invoice_date,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%y%m%d')
AND date_format(hr.invoice_date,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%y%m%d')
AND (hr.receipt_type IN (2, 3, 6, 7, 9) OR (hr.receipt_type in (8) AND dr.plan_quantity < 0)) GROUP BY dr.product_id, wr.warehouse_name ) ER on dr.product_id = ER.product_id
join ( SELECT dr.product_id, COALESCE(SUM(case when hr.receipt_type in (1, 4, 5, 8, 10) then dr.plan_quantity when hr.receipt_type in (2, 3, 6, 7, 9) then -dr.plan_quantity else 0 end), 0) as CBPlanQuantity, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(case when hr.receipt_type in (1, 4, 5, 8, 10) then dr.money when hr.receipt_type in (2, 3, 6, 7, 9) then -dr.money else 0 end), 0), 2) as CBMoney from detail_receipt dr join head_receipt hr on hr.systematic_receipt = dr.systematic_receipt WHERE hr.receipt_status = 2
AND date_format(hr.invoice_date,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%y%m%d')
GROUP BY product_id ) CB on dr.product_id = CB.product_id WHERE 1=1
AND dr.warehousing_id = #{warehousingId}
AND dr.retrieval_id = #{retrievalId}
AND p.product_code like concat('%', #{productCode}, '%')
AND p.product_name like concat('%', #{productName}, '%')
